name: Confiding In Others
overview: Scripture reveals that God designed humanity for companionship and mutual support, as seen in His provision of a suitable helper for man (Genesis 2:18). Walking with wise companions leads to wisdom, while associating with fools brings destruction (Proverbs 13:20). Wise speech and conduct build up the household, contrasting with the harm caused by foolishness and strife (Proverbs 14:1; 15:2; 19:13). The early church’s attention to equitable care among believers exemplifies the importance of addressing concerns within the community through open, faithful communication (Acts 6:1). Together, these verses underscore the biblical call to confide in others wisely and lovingly, fostering unity and godly growth.
